title: Berlin Early Morning - Quick Summary
items: **Berlin opens late, so the early hours belong to the free things.** Nothing with a ticket desk opens before 08:00, and the earliest museum in the centre is the DDR Museum at 09:00. Museum Island does not unlock until 10:00 and is closed all day Monday.

**Everything without a gate is already open.** The field of stelae at the Holocaust Memorial is accessible 24 hours a day, and Tiergarten, the East Side Gallery pavement, Volkspark Humboldthain and Alexanderplatz have no gates at all.

**Check where sunrise falls before you set an alarm.** Berlin sits at 52 degrees north, so the sun is up at 04:43 in late June, around 06:05 in late August and not until 08:15 just before Christmas. In November to February there is no point being outside before eight.

**Weekday nights have a transport gap; weekends do not.** The last U-Bahn out of Alexanderplatz leaves around 00:50 on a weekday and the first is back at 04:05, with night buses marked N and the M1 and M2 trams covering the hours between. On Saturday and Sunday mornings the U-Bahn and S-Bahn run right through the night.

**Tempelhofer Feld is the best early move.** The gates of the old airport open at 06:00 from March to September, 07:00 in February, October and November, and 07:30 in January and December. Allow about 30 minutes from Alexanderplatz.

**A 07:00 swim is the local version.** Sommerbad Humboldthain opens at 07:00 Tuesday to Sunday and at 10:00 on Mondays, for 7 euros, and closes anywhere between 20:00 in high summer and 18:00 by early September. The 2026 outdoor season ends on 11 September, and everyone aged 14 and over needs an original photo ID at the gate.

**Then the doors open in order:** 08:00 the Reichstag visitor service point, 09:00 the TV Tower, the DDR Museum, Zoo Berlin and the Berliner Dom from Monday to Saturday, 12:00 the Berliner Dom on a Sunday, 10:00 Museum Island.
